transactions.property_name: ION Orchard and ION Orchard Link
transactions.citation: Note 32 (p185): total purchase consideration S$1,073,023k for the 50.0% interest, net of assumed JV debt; agreed property value on 100% basis S$3,697.0m; independent valuations as at 31 July 2024: Savills S$3,715.0m, Cushman & Wakefield S$3,690.0m
transactions.notes: Acquired 50.0% interest via CRSI/OTH/IOL joint ventures (asset acquisition accounting, not a business combination). Agreed 100%-basis property value S$3,697.0m compared against the midpoint of the two independent valuations (S$3,702.5m) => (3,697.0-3,702.5)/3,702.5 = -0.15% (marginal discount). purchase_price of S$1,073,023k is the 50% equity/JV consideration (net of assumed JV debt), NOT directly the reference used for gain_loss_pct which is on a 100% property-value basis matching the reference_value basis; do not divide purchase_price by reference_value. Acquisition-cost-inclusive total S$1,095,215k; net cash outflow S$1,079,322k (Note 32). Property absent from the audited investment-property Portfolio Statement — recorded via JV/associate accounting.

transactions.counterparty: Sun View SG I Pte. Ltd.
transactions.citation: p136 Note 33: 'the Group recognised a net gain on divestment of investment property of $32.8 million'; net proceeds S$672,607k after divestment-related payments of S$15,393k (Note 33)
transactions.notes: Carrying value derived per accounting policy (gain/loss = net proceeds - carrying amount): 672,607 - 32,765 = 639,842 (SGD). gain_loss_pct = disclosed net gain S$32,765k / derived carrying value S$639,842k = +5.12% (pct_source=derived; the AR discloses the dollar gain, not a percentage). Sold at gross consideration S$688.0m, equal to the Savills valuation as at 31 Oct 2024 (0% premium to that valuation, not separately recorded as a second row since the spec's five fields are for one reference basis per row). Percentage is computed on NET proceeds after disposal costs (per rule 7 of spec) rather than the S$688.0m gross price; gross_sale_price = S$688,000k. Portfolio Statement (p107) shows a dash for this property's FY2024 carrying value since it was divested before year-end.
